classification_policy.acceptance_extension: The exact live or raw source_name is an explicit CrucibleCraft copper/tin/iron acceptance extension for this domain and is absent from that domain's direct GT6 calls.
classification_policy.direct_source: The exact live or raw source_name is an argument of the domain's pinned GT6 addFluidPipes or addItemPipes call.
classification_policy.not_applicable: The exact source_name is neither direct GT6 pipe source nor an explicit acceptance extension for this domain.

import_architecture.runtime_catalog_generation: derive every selected material/gauge row from exact source_name and policy classification
import_architecture.source_of_truth: tools/gt6_pipe_source.json plus explicit tools/t8_pipe_policy.json acceptance extensions

nonmetal_fluid_pipe_acquisition.decision: Keep all GT6 recipe flags false; use the five exact GT6 Wood crafting rows and twenty explicit CrucibleCraft DESIGN_POLICY_NON_GT6 shaped rows recorded by the T19c acquisition artifact.

cover_set_version.reason: PipeCoverSet.version had no production consumer; cover mutations already invalidate PipeTopology and synchronize the owning block entity.

outgoing_cover_guard.reason: T8 one-way valves intentionally restrict face-to-pipe input only; the former allowsOutgoing(Direction) method always returned true and made four guards non-falsifiable.

semantic_model.extensions: CrucibleCraft acceptance extensions are policy-owned rows and are never direct GT6 source.
semantic_model.fluid_capacity: Tiny/small/normal/large/huge store aStat multiplied by 1/2/6/12/24 respectively.
semantic_model.fluid_eligibility: Only an exact addFluidPipes material argument is direct GT6 fluid-pipe evidence.
semantic_model.fluid_temperature: The overload without aMaxTemperature stores floor(material melting Kelvin * 1.25); the explicit overload stores its literal aMaxTemperature.
semantic_model.item_eligibility: Only an exact addItemPipes material argument is direct GT6 item-pipe evidence.
semantic_model.item_transport: Normal/large/huge store aStepSize divided by 1/2/4 and aInvSize multiplied by 1/2/4 respectively.

gtm_reference.role: Naming and geometry reference only; GT6 direct registrations remain authoritative for T8 material eligibility and pipe statistics.
